myj.label: MYJ PBL
warnings: MYJ PBL is implemented-unverified because no matched ArWen-versus-WRF forecast trajectory exists for it, but its CUDA kernel (gpuwm/core/kernels/myjpbl.cu) is BIT-IDENTICAL to WRF v4.6.1's own MYJPBL. tools/myjpbl_wrf461_oracle compiles the byte-unmodified phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F at gfortran 13.3 -O0 (WRF's own -O2 -ftree-vectorize -funroll-loops build writes the same bytes) and drives it over 176 columns -- convective, stable night, neutral, ocean, snow, sea ice, cloud liquid and ice, terrain from -25 to 4500 m, the QCI-present and QCI-absent arms, nz 4, 35, 50 and 128, DT 10 to 90 s, and edge columns (CT /= 0, CHKLOWQ = 0, dew, USTAR = 0, calm, exactly neutral, TKE floor, LPBL = 1, subnormal condensate) -- for three consecutive calls; the fixture executes every line of MYJPBL's call tree except PRODQ2's ELOQN <= EPS1 arm (:1145-1146). Under the strict build (GPUWM_WRF_EXACT=1) every word of every output (TKE_MYJ, EL_MYJ, EXCH_H, the six tendencies, PBLH, MIXHT, KPBL, THZ0, QZ0, QSFC, CT) is identical, replayed and free-running; under default arithmetic (CuPy's -ftz=true) only RQCBLTEN/RQIBLTEN words differ, each by less than FLT_MIN (at most 1.2e-38), where diffusion leaves subnormal condensate (tests/test_myjpbl_wrf461_parity.py). The kernel seeds ZINT(KTE+1)=HT as WRF does (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:312), calls WOOF's own float32 gfk_exp_fma/gfk_pow (matched to the oracle host's C library over all 2**32 inputs by tools/myjpbl_wrf461_oracle/libm_sweep.py), compiles without FMA contraction and carries gfortran's folded constant words. That is conformance evidence, not scientific validation.

MYJ requires the Eta similarity surface layer. EEPS also admits Eta with its independently allocated native-zero TKE column. WRF's MYJ law is one-directional -- phys/module_physics_init.F:3770-3772 fatals bl_pbl_physics=2 unless the surface layer set isfc=2, which only sf_sfclay_physics=2 does among the layers gpuwm ports (:3169) -- and ArWen adds the reverse refusal for a stated reason: the Eta layer publishes AKHS/AKMS/THZ0/QZ0/UZ0/VZ0 and publishes NO MOL, ZOL, PSIM/PSIH, REGIME, GZ1OZ0 or WSPD (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:361-1056), while YSU, MYNN, Shin-Hong and SASE each read at least one of those. Pairing them would hand a PBL scheme a zero where WRF hands it a similarity function: finite, plausible and wrong. gpuwm.config.validate_myj_pairing is that refusal.

WRF quirks transcribed rather than repaired, each cited in the port. CT (the countergradient correction) is identically zero in ARW: MYJSFC zeroes it every call (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:206-211) and SFCDIF's countergradient block is commented out (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:816-825, CT=0.), so MIXLEN's DTH+CT fix (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:845-850) and VDIFH's RKCT term add exactly zero -- both seams are still built so a future WRF that restores them lands in the right place. CZIL is hard-coded to 0.1 because the Chen-Zhang block is commented out (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:689-697), which is why IVGTYP/ISURBAN/IZ0TLND are dead arguments and why gpuwm.config refuses isftcflx/iz0tlnd with this surface layer. The Zilitinkevich thermal-roughness fix reads Z0BASE, not the working ZNT (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:733). DIFCOF's inversion block is commented out (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:1275-1322), so its T argument is dead and the port does not take it.

OUT OF SCOPE, refused rather than approximated. WRF sends the MYJ PBL through myjurb (phys/module_bl_myjurb.F:130-771) when sf_urban_physics is 2 or 3, the BEP/BEM multi-layer urban canopies (phys/module_physics_init.F:3775-3781). gpuwm does the same: PhysicsDriver._run_myj_pbl routes MYJ to gpuwm.core.myjurb under the bep and bep-bem urban options. With sf_surface_physics=0 the land branch stops evolving surface humidity rather than failing: MYJPBL rebuilds QSFC over land from ELFLX and CHKLOWQ, both of which an LSM writes, and its IF(QFC1>0.) guard leaves QSFC untouched when they are zero (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:547-557). That is WRF's own behaviour and it is admitted, not refused -- but a land run without an LSM is a land run whose surface moisture is frozen at its initial value. The MYJPBL species stack is WRF's own three or four rows (theta, vapour, cloud water and cloud ice when the moist set carries it): the QCS/QCR/QCG rows the source declares are commented out upstream (:274-285) and are not ported. The kernel holds the column in per-thread local memory like YSU's, so it carries the same 128-level ceiling and refuses a deeper column rather than truncating it.

mynn.label: MYNN PBL
warnings: UNVERIFIED against a WRF forecast. MYNN PBL runs through the exact production driver, with phim/phih evaluated on the device. Cold-column fixtures are bitwise WRF v4.6.1 on every oracle in tests/test_mynn_wrf461_exact_gpu.py; the stock and gsd_41 family drivers and restart controls are described by the selected MYNN review receipts. This is component qualification, not a matched full WRF forecast or observation skill.

Cycled stock MYNN carries QKE, QC_BL and CLDFRA_BL by default. Its column comparison uses the three-assignment repaired referee: only the upstream assignments that erase these held arrays are removed. Cold starts retain their stock behavior. tests/test_mynn_wrf461_cycled_carry_gpu.py and tests/test_mynn_restart_live_gpu.py retain the raw-word and continuation checks; other columns and compiler platforms are not qualified by this declaration.

An admitted option is limited by the actual MYNN configuration and consumer tables. Unsupported closure, cloud-PDF and diagnostic values still refuse before the driver; cycling and restart are not blanket refusals.

scalar_diffusion_exchange.reason: WRF skips the PBL driver with no PBL, so scalar_pblmix mixes nothing.

wrf_vertical_diffusion_2.wrf_coefficient_policy: dyn_em/module_diffusion_em.F:2018-2023 sets xkmv=xkmh and xkhv=0 for km_opt=4

required_settings_reasons.khdif: constant-K diffusion may not silently stack on the SASE mixing
required_settings_reasons.km_opt: SASE computes its own horizontal mixing from the closure's own diffusivities, so a km_opt mixing operator would double-count it
required_settings_reasons.kvdif: constant-K diffusion may not silently stack on the SASE mixing
required_settings_reasons.moist: the closure mixes water vapour, cloud water and cloud ice beside theta and forms its stability from the saturated Brunt-Vaisala frequency; a dry state has nothing for it to integrate

requires_components_reasons.surface_layer: SASE's lower boundary condition is the surface layer's friction velocity, heat and moisture fluxes and gust-corrected wind speed (ust/hfx/qfx/wspd); the off option writes none of them

scalar_diffusion_exchange.reason: SASE has no WRF counterpart and publishes a layer diffusivity for its own split solve, not lower-interface EXCH_H; reading it as EXCH_H would shift the vertical fluxes, so scalar_pblmix mixes nothing.

sase.label: SASE PBL
warnings: EXPERIMENTAL, AND NOT A WRF SCHEME. SASE (Scale-Adaptive Stress-Energetics) is an ArWen-only turbulence closure with no WRF v4.6.1 counterpart, so no oracle comparison against WRF Fortran exists or can exist for it, and it carries no WRF selector number -- bl_pbl_physics=900 is outside WRF's namespace on purpose. Every other option in this registry is measured as a distance from WRF; this one cannot be. Read its maturity as 'the numerics are self-checked', never as 'the physics is validated'.

SCIENTIFICALLY UNVALIDATED, and its own acceptance scorecard says so. Scored against a single reference case on a single day, the closure met 2 of 7 frozen physical acceptance bars and missed 5, including a total absence of the low-cloud deck that its conditional-venting limb exists to act on (median liquid water path 0.0 g/m2 against a reference of 132-235). Nothing measured speaks to any other case. Do not use it for a forecast you intend to believe.

KNOWN OPEN BIAS in the subgrid energy magnitude: the one-constant closure's equilibrium subgrid TKE sits roughly 3-5x below the observed value (sqrt(e) about 2x low), which biases the stability lengths, the horizontal diffusivity, the buoyancy flux and every TKE product it writes. This is registered and unfixed, and it blocks scientific claims about TKE magnitudes.

RUNTIME RESTRICTIONS, refused at config load rather than warned: the closure replaces the km_opt mixing operator so it requires km_opt=0 and khdif=kvdif=0 (stacking would double-count); it requires a surface-layer scheme, because its lower boundary condition is that scheme's friction velocity and heat/moisture fluxes; it requires moist=true; its vertical momentum tendency is held across the configured PBL interval and checkpointed; and its implicit vertical solve carries its tridiagonal columns in per-thread local memory, which bounds it to nz <= 128.

HORIZONTAL OPERATORS WRAP PERIODICALLY. The test filters, strain and horizontal flux stencils wrap in x and y unconditionally. On a specified or nested domain the mitigation is that the subgrid energy is held at its floor across the outer spec_bdy_width rows every step and the same width is excluded from the closure's solve reductions -- an adjudicated boundary treatment, not a halo exchange.

MEASURED ON REAL DATA, AND IT DID NOT COMPLETE. The closure's first forecast on operational input -- GFS 2026-08-01 18Z, one 306x244x49 domain at 12 km over North America, through the shipped `gpuwm go` front door -- ran one forecast hour and then failed the full-state health gate with EVERY prognostic class violated (wind, specific volume, theta, moisture, moment): u = -522 m/s at k=38. Two things were measured in the clean hour before it. (1) A SPURIOUS SECOND TURBULENCE MAXIMUM aloft: the prognostic subgrid energy falls to its floor above the boundary layer as it should, and then REGROWS between 11.3 and 13.9 km to 1.62 m2/s2 -- 62 percent of its own boundary-layer peak of 2.60 -- centred on k=38, the level the gate then failed at. A boundary-layer closure has no business producing energy of that order at the tropopause, and with the km_opt=0 this scheme requires there is no other horizontal operator up there to damp it. (2) A DEEPER BOUNDARY LAYER THAN THE CONTROL THROUGHOUT: PBLH median 1967 m against 1558 m, p90 3962 against 2793, maximum 8900 against 4847, and 9.5 percent of columns above 4 km against 1.2 percent. Read the co-location of the aloft maximum and the failure level as a lead, not as a proven cause: this is ONE case, ONE cycle and ONE hour, and the same configuration also failed the gate under the stock YSU control -- later, at 3 h, and on the wind class alone. What separates them is not measured, and cannot be with the configuration schema as it stands: km_opt=0 is admitted only with this scheme, so the control that would hold the mixing configuration fixed and vary only the closure cannot be expressed.

The MYNN surface layer is admitted under SASE on the field contract alone: it publishes the friction velocity, the heat and moisture fluxes and the gust-corrected wind speed the closure reads, and nothing else in the closure is surface-layer specific. No trajectory evidence covers this pairing -- the measured SASE runs are all revised/classic MM5 -- so it is experimentable, not evidenced.

wrf_counterpart.basis: WRF v4.6.1 registers no scale-adaptive stress-energetics PBL package; Registry/Registry.EM_COMMON declares bl_pbl_physics packages through 99 and none of them is this closure. The selector 900 is outside that namespace on purpose so it can never collide with a scheme WRF adds later.
wrf_counterpart.consequence: The conformance ladder measures agreement with WRF, so it cannot rank this option against anything. It holds 'implemented-unverified' permanently rather than pending work: there is no oracle to run and no matched trajectory to produce. Evidence for it accrues on the independent-scientific axis (scientific_evidence), which reads 'none' today.

requires_components_reasons.surface_layer: Shin-Hong binds fm/fh, the full similarity denominators ln(z/z0)-psi, directly and divides by them (zol = br*fm^2/fh); only the revised and classic MM5 surface layers publish them, so any other surface layer leaves them at their allocated zeros and the PBL runs on finite, plausible, wrong values for the whole forecast

scalar_diffusion_exchange.reason: Shin-Hong publishes heat diffusivity at lower interfaces.

shinhong.label: Shin-Hong PBL
warnings: Shin-Hong's distance from WRF v4.6.1 is MEASURED on both halves of the port. tools/shinhong_wrf461_oracle drives the byte-frozen phys/module_bl_shinhong.F at gfortran -O0 over a 30-case x 6-grid-spacing x 40-level fixture built to reach branches, and the float32 CPU authority gpuwm/verify/shinhong_ref.py reproduces every output field of both arms bitwise -- max ULP 0 (tests/test_shinhong_wrf461_parity.py). The CUDA kernel's distance from the same pinned WRF words was measured 2026-08-03 on one RTX 5090 and is asserted for EQUALITY in the same test module: the heat tendency bitwise (0 ULP on every non-NaN lane through both tridiagonal solves), PBLH/WSTAR/DELTA 1 ULP, EXCH_H 8, EL 14, TKE 2022, and momentum/moisture tendencies up to 9.3e4/3.5e5 ULP -- near-total cancellations (the worst du lane is 3.4966e-06 against 3.4756e-06 m/s2) plus the flush lanes the last warning records. That is conformance evidence, not scientific validation: no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison exists for this scheme, and no gpuwm run has ever been checked against WRF with bl_pbl_physics=11. That is why this option is 'implemented-unverified' and not 'supported'.

DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE, WRF is undefined: with the TKE diagnostic on and the PBL filling the column (kpbl == kte), module_bl_shinhong.F:1557 reads q2xk(kpbl+1), one element past an array declared kts:kte. Both halves of the port compute the entrainment flux efxpbl only for kpbl < kte -- the defined behaviour -- behind the guards at gpuwm/verify/shinhong_ref.py:1275 and kernels/shinhong.cu:1602, and the oracle fixture never exercises the undefined arm: case 22, the kpbl == kte column, runs tke_diag=0 for exactly this reason.

WRF's OWN 0/0, reproduced rather than repaired: when ust is subnormal its cube underflows to exactly zero, and with hfx=+0.0, qfx=-0.0 the surface-flux term wstar3 is zero while sfcflg stays true, so module_bl_shinhong.F:1010 computes prfac2 = 15.9*wstar3/ust3/(1.+4.*karman*wstar3/ust3) = 0/0 and the NaN fills the heat column through the tridiagonal solve. The fixture pins one such column (case 13) and the authority and the kernel both reproduce the identical NaN geometry, pinned as lane counts. Those lanes are held out of the bitwise table by the NaN token alone: the oracle's ES24.16E3 format wrote sign-less NaN, so the receipt cannot say which payload WRF held and bit identity is unknowable there -- geometry, count and location are pinned instead.

sm_120/FTZ, MEASURED in both directions -- countermeasured where it picked a branch, recorded where it flushes words. WRF selects the stability regime with br .gt. 0.0 (module_bl_shinhong.F:702-715, transcribed at gpuwm/verify/shinhong_ref.py:706); sm_120 DAZes a positive SUBNORMAL br to zero in every FP32 compare, and the plain-float32 kernel measurably took the convective arm where WRF takes the stable one (case 7: wstar 0.2362 against WRF's 0.0). The kernel closes that with the sh_f2d double-compare countermeasure and tests/test_shinhong_wrf461_parity.py proves the branch stays WRF's, so no branch divergence is held out of the parity table. What remains is the tendency flush: CuPy appends -ftz=true unconditionally and sm_120 flushes regardless, so on the 72 lanes where the pinned WRF module wrote a subnormal qv/qc/qi tendency (e.g. 4.28e-39) the kernel writes exactly zero -- physically nil, pinned as lane counts so neither the flush nor the fixture's reach can quietly disappear. This is the same mechanism the YSU warnings record as an OPEN correctness bug; here it is closed at the branch and bounded at the words.

requires_components_reasons.surface_layer: TEMF shares TE_TEMF and HD_TEMF between its PBL and surface layer; another pairing leaves that carried total energy and thermal height without their required writer (WRF v4.6.1 share/module_check_a_mundo.F:2294-2299)

scalar_diffusion_exchange.reason: WRF module_pbl_driver.F:1173-1204 passes KH_TEMF and KM_TEMF to TEMF, without an EXCH_H argument; the scalar_pblmix seam has no TEMF EXCH_H writer.

temf.label: TEMF pbl
warnings: Native WRF v4.6.1 real-run input replay under strict numerics: PBL 0/7136 differing words; surface layer 0/160. Native PBL arithmetic and the upper mass-flux recurrence are retained. The surface zero-moisture limit is declared separately. Observation-based forecast skill is not established.

requires_components_reasons.surface_layer: the UW scheme takes its lower boundary from the friction velocity and the surface heat and moisture fluxes (UST/HFX/QFX), which the revised MM5, classic MM5, MYNN and GFS surface layers publish; the Eta layer publishes them too but its own PBLH scan reads the TKE_MYJ column only the MYJ PBL advances, and the off option writes none of them

uw.label: UW moist-turbulence PBL
warnings: The UW PBL's distance from WRF v4.7.1 is MEASURED against the byte-unmodified CAMUWPBL sources: tools/uwpbl_wrf471_oracle builds them at gfortran -O0 and records every step of six regime families (convective day, stable night, stratocumulus, valley cold pool, mixed-phase, shallow cumulus) on three vertical grids, and the binary64 CPU reference gpuwm/verify/uwpbl_ref and the CUDA kernel are graded against those words bit for bit (tests/test_uwpbl_driver_wrf471_parity.py). That is conformance evidence, not scientific validation: no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison and no observation score exists for this scheme yet, which is why this option is 'implemented-unverified'.

THE ONE LICENCE-BOUND DIFFERENCE: WRF's cos and acos are glibc's binary64 IBM Accurate Mathematical Library (LGPL), which is not transcribed; the kernel uses correctly rounded cos/acos instead (gpuwm/core/kernels/glibc_flt64.cuh). They enter only the trigonometric root of the entrainment cubic, and where glibc does not round correctly there a column can differ from WRF in its last bits; the rate is measured and stated in the kernel header. exp, log and pow are glibc's own (Arm optimized-routines, MIT) and bitwise.

WRF-AS-BUILT: gfortran's -O2 -ftree-vectorize build of these sources (WRF's configure default) is not byte-identical to its -O0 build on this toolchain: the vectoriser routes loops in eddy_diff through libmvec's cos/pow and folds x**2._r8 to x*x. The port follows the -O0 build, which calls glibc's scalar functions everywhere.

requires_components_reasons.surface_layer: YSU binds fm/fh, the full similarity denominators ln(z/z0)-psi, directly and divides by them (zol = br*fm^2/fh); only the revised and classic MM5 surface layers publish them, so any other surface layer leaves them at their allocated zeros and the PBL runs on finite, plausible, wrong values for the whole forecast

scalar_diffusion_exchange.reason: YSU publishes heat diffusivity at lower interfaces.

ysu.label: YSU PBL

declared_corrections: Bound explicit nonlocal heat/vapor entrainment by its discrete donor-jump Courant number (default arithmetic; strict reproduction retains upstream).
Bound the get_pblh searches and set the upstream unwritten final TKE word to zero in shallow domains.
Remove the whole YSU surface drag under BEP because its source terms already include rural drag.

warnings: YSU RUNS and is BITWISE against WRF on its oracle. Until 2026-07-26 this option was maturity 'supported' with no warnings and no WRF number of any kind: the CUDA kernel had only ever been compared to gpuwm.verify.npref.np_ysu_column, a float64 mirror of the same transcription. tools/ysu_wrf461_oracle drives bl_ysu_run in the byte-unmodified phys/physics_mmm/bl_ysu.F90 at the pinned commit and dumps 24 columns x 40 levels of inputs and outputs. Every word the kernel writes on the 23 columns where WRF writes numbers is WRF's word (tests/test_ysu_wrf461_parity.py, RTX PRO 6000 under NVRTC 13.4.92 and 12.9.86 alike), except 11 subnormal tendencies the card flushes (below), and KPBL is WRF's on all 24. That took (lane/parity-286, 2026-10-05): glibc's powf and expf in place of CUDA's, every real-exponent ** spelled as the powf call gfortran makes, WRF's association expression by expression, the unit compiled without multiply-add contraction, WRF's thx = (th*pi)/pi and (ttend*pi)/pi round trips, the br > 0 regime compare made in double so a positive subnormal br takes WRF's stable arm, and WRF's ctopo surface-drag arm (bl_ysu.F90:1308), which WRF's driver passes on every run (module_bl_ysu.F:404).

CLOSED 2026-10-12 (golden/ports-pbl): the zero-flux short circuit. The kernel used to return zero tendencies, PBLH = dz(1) and KPBL = 1 whenever UST, HFX and QFX were all zero, and -ftz made the same branch fire on a subnormal UST. bl_ysu_run has no such branch; the kernel and the float64 mirror now run the whole scheme there, and the oracle's calm column (a 703 m PBL with nine levels, EXCH_M 0.143 m2/s) is WRF's word on every lane.

WRF's default surface-drag arm is implemented: module_bl_ysu.F:404 passes ctopo and ctopo2 and bl_ysu.F90:1308 applies their drag. The selected kernel carries the paj, GET_PBLH and Beljaars vconv calculation; tests/test_ysu_wrf461_parity.py pins zero momentum ULP against that arm and retains the separate 182 ULP comparison to the historical ctopo-absent reference. This is column evidence, not qualification against a WRF forecast.

-ftz=true also FLUSHES SUBNORMAL TENDENCIES to exactly zero. Eleven lanes of the oracle fixture carry a subnormal qv/qc/qi tendency from WRF and the kernel writes zero in all eleven, which reads as up to 207470 ULP but is 3.3e-13 kg/kg/s. Physically nil; it is recorded because it is the same mechanism as the subnormal-br regime bug closed above, where the consequence was not nil.

UNVERIFIED against a WRF forecast. The oracle compares one YSU call at a time on synthetic columns. No gpuwm/WRF trajectory comparison exists for this scheme, and no gpuwm run has ever been checked against WRF with bl_pbl_physics=1. That is why this is 'implemented-unverified' and not 'supported'.

DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE, WRF is undefined: with ust**3 underflowed to zero, wstar3 zero and sfcflg true, bl_ysu.F90:963 computes prfac2 = 15.9*(wstar3+wstar3_2)/ust3/(1.+4.*karman*(...)/ust3) = 0/0 and fills the heat-tendency column with NaN -- pinned in the oracle fixture (case 13). gpuwm returns the defined algebraic value there and is WRF's word on every lane WRF wrote a number, KPBL and PBLH included. Separately, at kpbl == kte with cloud at kpbl-1, bl_ysu.F90:846 reads thlix(i,k+2) one element past an array declared kts:kte; kernels/ysu_480.cu:482 guards that access with kpbl < nz and skips the top-down block instead.

wrf-cam3.label: WRF CAM3 longwave and shortwave
wrf-cam3.verification_scope_note: WRF v4.6.1 strict GPU replay of 96 columns captured during the 2000-01-24 12-15 UTC native forecast checks 145440 returned words: 142368 defined words are bitwise equal and 3072 cloud optical-depth words are a witnessed native-undefined residue in LW-only calls. Rust initialization matches 21962220 state bytes and 480 gas words. The complete fast-numerics gpuwm go forecast has Rust maps at 13, 14 and 15 UTC beside native WRF and surface observations; exact real checkpoint continuation and GPU nest/member checks are recorded in docs/cam3-port-proof.json. At 4096 columns x 32 layers, refresh/reuse take 121.57/36.07 ms versus legacy RRTMG 11.95 ms. The 1.2x target is exceeded: native binary64 layer-pair absorption and aerosol work are retained; compiler frame and column-parallelism bottlenecks were fixed. warnings: The packaged co2tf=0 CONRAD table has 42 layers and requires its matching vertical grid; co2tf=1 computes transmission for the selected grid. Native ozone tables allow at most 81 layers. Strict replay matches captured native words; default hardware math differs. One three-hour real forecast and idealized nest lifecycle checks do not establish general forecast skill. The inherited WK82 relocation verifier refuses its open parent on the unchanged candidate before moving; that independent check remains open.

wrf-rrtm-dudhia.label: WRF RRTM longwave + Dudhia shortwave
warnings: WRF RRTM LONGWAVE IS BITWISE AGAINST WRF ON ITS COLUMN ORACLE. gpuwm/core/rrtm_lw.py, gpuwm/core/rrtm_taumol.py and gpuwm/core/rrtm_tables.py transcribe phys/module_ra_rrtm.F (O3DATA, MM5ATM, SETCOEF, CMBGB1-16, TAUGB1-16, GASABS, RTRN, RRTM/RRTMLWRAD) and the coefficient tables are the packaged RRTM_DATA records reduced 256 g-points to 140 by the module's own CMBGB weighting. tools/rrtm_lw_wrf461_oracle compiles the byte-unmodified module at the pinned WRF v4.6.1 commit (gfortran 13.3.0, glibc 2.39, -O0) and drives RRTMLWRAD on 79 columns in 7 calls: deep convection, stable nights, snow and ice, ocean, 580-705 hPa terrain and edge cases (a 1085 hPa surface, 340 K and 342 K surfaces, SETCOEF's pressure switches hit exactly, negative and subnormal mixing ratios, icloud=0, Kessler's flags), with 25, 13, 3, 1 and 0 Cavallo buffer layers. On that fixture every RTHRATEN, RTHRATENC, GLW and OLR word, every MM5ATM/SETCOEF/GASABS/RTRN intermediate and every rrtm_lookuptable table equals WRF's (0 ULP) on the NumPy path and on the GPU under GPUWM_WRF_EXACT=1; under default GPU arithmetic the outputs are also 0 ULP and only TAUCLOUD on 10 subnormal-mixing-ratio layers differs (flushed to zero). tests/test_rrtm_lw_wrf461_parity.py is the gate. Reaching it took WRF's float32 BPADE and FLUXFAC, WOOF's own float32 libm for EXP, LOG and **, the Fortran accumulation order for O3DATA's and RTRN's sums, P/100 as a division, the REAL(8) trace gases computed in float32, one association in eight TAUGB bands, and the 340 K Planck row (an OLR error of 2.3 W m-2 on a 340 K surface before). WRF's own -O2 -ftree-vectorize build moves 5 TAUCLOUD words by 1 ULP through libmvec's vector powf and no output. NOT COVERED: cal_cldfra1 and the MYNN cloud merge that produce CLDFRA upstream of RRTMLWRAD (radiation driver code, graded with the driver), level or layer temperatures outside the 160-340 K Planck table (WRF reads out of bounds there and the port holds the end row), and any matched WRF forecast trajectory.

The 1/1 pair is a COMPOSITION, not a coupled adapter: RRTMDudhiaRadiation runs gpuwm.core.rrtm_lw.RRTMLongwaveRadiation and gpuwm.core.dudhia.DudhiaShortwaveRadiation and merges their results, mirroring module_radiation_driver.F's independent lwrad_select/swrad_select dispatch. RRTM owns GLW (provenance 'scheme'), so the pair never depends on a carried-in GLW value.

Supported path only, fail-closed elsewhere: no WRF-Chem, ghg_input=0 (the analytic year-dependent CO2/N2O/CH4 of RRTMLWRAD F:1855-1861), O3DATA's own summer/winter ozone climatology, and no CFC/CCl4 cross sections (WRF's MM5ATM sets WX to zero, F:4005-4009). Longwave and shortwave selections compose independently.

PERFORMANCE AND TRANSIENT MEMORY: classic RRTM evaluates CuPy column blocks. The experiment column_chunk setting now caps those blocks as well as modern radiation; reducing it lowers solver workspace and may increase dispatch time without changing the per-column answer. Preflight prices the actual window, pressure-dependent buffer layers, coefficient tables and capped solver live sets. Bare legacy configurations with an unresolved pressure top retain an explicitly unpriced classic workspace until initialization supplies it.

requires_components_reasons.pbl: the Eta surface layer publishes no fm/fh, the full similarity denominators ln(z/z0)-psi that YSU and Shin-Hong bind directly and divide by, so under it they would divide by an allocated zero; and its PBLH scan reads its registered TKE column. EEPS preserves the native allocation zero; MYJ evolves it with its own closure

arwen_pairing_requirement.classification: ArWen structural constraint; WRF v4.6.1 admits sf_sfclay_physics=2 with PBL schemes gpuwm does not port (phys/module_physics_init.F:3742, phys/module_physics_init.F:3756)
arwen_pairing_requirement.reason: the Eta surface layer's published set is not the MM5 layers' published set. YSU and Shin-Hong need FM/FH, which it does not publish. EEPS consumes its actual flux outputs and preserves the separate Eta TKE column

eta-similarity.label: Eta similarity surface layer
warnings: The Eta similarity surface layer is implemented-unverified because no matched ArWen-versus-WRF forecast trajectory exists for it, but its CUDA kernel (gpuwm/core/kernels/myjsfc.cu) and its host similarity tables are BIT-IDENTICAL to WRF v4.6.1's own MYJSFC and MYJSFCINIT. tools/myjsfc_wrf461_oracle compiles the byte-unmodified phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F at gfortran 13.3 -O0 (WRF's own -O2 -ftree-vectorize -funroll-loops build writes the same bytes; neither has an FMA or a libmvec call) and drives 224 columns -- convective and stable land, snow and sea ice, warm, cold and storm-force ocean, terrain to 4.4 km, calm air, cloud water, a TKE column that never drops below EPSQ2 and a dead one, a boundary layer above 1000 m, extreme instability and stability, a saturated cold column, a lowest layer under 4 m and the two-level minimum column -- through MYJSFCINIT and three consecutive MYJSFC calls (cold start at ITIMESTEP 1 and warm seeded state across the three sea viscous regimes); the fixture executes every line of MYJSFC and SFCDIF. Every word of all 35 INOUT and output fields is identical, replayed and free-running, under the strict build (GPUWM_WRF_EXACT=1) and under default arithmetic, and all 4 x 10,001 PSIM/PSIH table words match (tests/test_myjsfc_wrf461_parity.py). A further 8,192 columns with randomly drawn regimes, four calls each (32,768 column-calls, tools/myjsfc_wrf461_oracle/stress.sh), are identical too, and so is the float32 CPU authority (gpuwm/verify/myj_ref.py np_myjsfc_column, graded on CPU). The kernel seeds ZINT(KTE+1)=HT as WRF does (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:165), calls WOOF's own float32 gfk_log/gfk_exp_fma/gfk_pow (graded against the oracle host's C library over all 2**32 inputs by tools/myjsfc_wrf461_oracle/libm_sweep.py: one input differs, 1 ULP of POW at x = 0.00825 with exponent 1/CAPA, which needs a surface pressure below 0.01 Pa) and compiles without FMA contraction; the host tables use WOOF's own float32 logf/atanf/expf. That is conformance evidence, not scientific validation.

MYJ requires the Eta similarity surface layer. EEPS also admits Eta with its independently allocated native-zero TKE column. WRF's MYJ law is one-directional -- phys/module_physics_init.F:3770-3772 fatals bl_pbl_physics=2 unless the surface layer set isfc=2, which only sf_sfclay_physics=2 does among the layers gpuwm ports (:3169) -- and ArWen adds the reverse refusal for a stated reason: the Eta layer publishes AKHS/AKMS/THZ0/QZ0/UZ0/VZ0 and publishes NO MOL, ZOL, PSIM/PSIH, REGIME, GZ1OZ0 or WSPD (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:361-1056), while YSU, MYNN, Shin-Hong and SASE each read at least one of those. Pairing them would hand a PBL scheme a zero where WRF hands it a similarity function: finite, plausible and wrong. gpuwm.config.validate_myj_pairing is that refusal.

WRF quirks transcribed rather than repaired, each cited in the port. CT (the countergradient correction) is identically zero in ARW: MYJSFC zeroes it every call (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:206-211) and SFCDIF's countergradient block is commented out (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:816-825, CT=0.), so MIXLEN's DTH+CT fix (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:845-850) and VDIFH's RKCT term add exactly zero -- both seams are still built so a future WRF that restores them lands in the right place. CZIL is hard-coded to 0.1 because the Chen-Zhang block is commented out (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:689-697), which is why IVGTYP/ISURBAN/IZ0TLND are dead arguments and why gpuwm.config refuses isftcflx/iz0tlnd with this surface layer. The Zilitinkevich thermal-roughness fix reads Z0BASE, not the working ZNT (phys/module_sf_myjsfc.F:733). DIFCOF's inversion block is commented out (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:1275-1322), so its T argument is dead and the port does not take it.

OUT OF SCOPE, refused rather than approximated. WRF sends the MYJ PBL through myjurb (phys/module_bl_myjurb.F:130-771) when sf_urban_physics is 2 or 3, the BEP/BEM multi-layer urban canopies (phys/module_physics_init.F:3775-3781). gpuwm does the same: PhysicsDriver._run_myj_pbl routes MYJ to gpuwm.core.myjurb under the bep and bep-bem urban options. With sf_surface_physics=0 the land branch stops evolving surface humidity rather than failing: MYJPBL rebuilds QSFC over land from ELFLX and CHKLOWQ, both of which an LSM writes, and its IF(QFC1>0.) guard leaves QSFC untouched when they are zero (phys/module_bl_myjpbl.F:547-557). That is WRF's own behaviour and it is admitted, not refused -- but a land run without an LSM is a land run whose surface moisture is frozen at its initial value. The MYJPBL species stack is WRF's own three or four rows (theta, vapour, cloud water and cloud ice when the moist set carries it): the QCS/QCR/QCG rows the source declares are commented out upstream (:274-285) and are not ported. The kernel holds the column in per-thread local memory like YSU's, so it carries the same 128-level ceiling and refuses a deeper column rather than truncating it.

requires_components_reasons.pbl: the GFS surface layer publishes UST, HFX, QFX, PSIM/PSIH, GZ1OZ0, BR, WSPD and the exchange coefficients, and no fm/fh, MOL, ZOL or REGIME (phys/module_sf_gfs.F:9-18): YSU and Shin-Hong divide by fm/fh (and WRF fatals them on isfc=2), the MYJ PBL needs AKHS/AKMS/THZ0/QZ0/UZ0/VZ0 that only the Eta layer writes, and MYNN and SASE read MYNN-layer fields this layer leaves at their allocated values, so each would run on zeros -- finite, plausible and wrong. The GFS PBL reads this published stability set, the UW PBL reads UST/HFX/QFX only, and PBL-off reads nothing

arwen_pairing_requirement.classification: ArWen structural constraint; WRF v4.6.1 admits sf_sfclay_physics=3 (isfc=2) with the GFS, MYJ, MYNN, BouLac and EEPS PBLs (phys/module_physics_init.F:3742,3771,3815,3838,3872)
arwen_pairing_requirement.reason: the GFS layer's published set is the exchange set plus PSIM/PSIH/GZ1OZ0/BR/WSPD; a PBL that binds fm/fh, MOL, ZOL or the Eta layer's AKHS family would read zeros

gfs.label: GFS surface layer
warnings: The strict CUDA module replay reproduced all 10,240 output words captured from two calls on eight native WRF ranks in a real 2026-10-16 09Z forecast, with zero differing words. GPUWM_WRF_EXACT=1 preserves native scalar rounding and libm; default arithmetic permits contraction and device libm. tools/sfgfs_wrf461_oracle additionally covers land, sea, stability branches and fractional ice. Module conformance alone is not forecast validation.

DECLARED DIVERGENCES, two WRF defects repaired in the FRACTIONAL_SEAICE wrapper: (1) WRF builds XLAND_SEA=2 for the open-water component of a sea-ice cell and passes XLAND to the open-water call (module_surface_driver.F:5751 vs :5772), so that component runs as land on a cell real.exe marked XLAND=1; gpuwm passes XLAND_SEA, as every other wrapper in the file does. (2) WRF keeps the open-water TSK_SEA local to the GFS wrapper (:5670), so the RUC reblend reads the driver's automatic TSK_SEA (:1370, :3561) unset; gpuwm publishes it. Outside sea-ice cells both are inert.

Not ported because WRF never runs it: PROGTM's soil model (GOTO 1111/2222/5555, module_sf_gfs.F:489-1432), PROGT2, KTSOIL/FUNCDF/FUNCKT/THSAT/TWLT and module_progtm's tables. No WRF v4.6.1 path executes them, so they have no output to grade.

admitted_setting_values_reasons.mynn_sfclay_variant: wrf_461 is WRF v4.6.1's MYNN surface layer and gsl_wrf39 the GSL WRF 3.9 fork's; the two solve different equations for z/L, so no other name can select either

requires_components_reasons.pbl: the MYNN surface layer publishes psim/psih/gz1oz0 and does NOT publish fm/fh, the full similarity denominators ln(z/z0)-psi that YSU and Shin-Hong bind directly and divide by (they reconstruct zol = br*fm^2/fh from them). Those two would run on the allocated zeros -- finite, plausible and wrong -- for the whole forecast. Select the revised MM5 (1) or classic MM5 (91) surface layer for them, or the MYNN PBL, SASE, the UW PBL, EEPS or no PBL scheme for this surface layer, all of which read only fields it publishes

mynn.label: MYNN surface layer
warnings: WRF v4.6.1 admits this surface layer with PBL off or MYNN PBL. MYNN PBL also admits revised/classic MM5 surface layers; the exact 16-cell authority is phys/module_physics_init.F:3699-3704,3837-3839 and is published under authority.wrf_v461_compatibility_matrix.

UNVERIFIED against a WRF forecast. The column solver is oracle-matched over land and water at max relative error 4.3e-7, and it has now run a 300-step coupled forecast, but no gpuwm/WRF trajectory comparison exists.

isftcflx 0, 1, 2 and 3 are ported, oracle-matched over water and wired through both the CPU reference and the CUDA kernel: 0 is COARE 3.0 (charnock_1955 z0, fairall_etal_2003 zt/zq), 1 is davis_etal_2008 z0 with COARE 3.0 zt/zq, 2 is davis_etal_2008 z0 with the water arm of garratt_1992, and 3 is Taylor_Yelland_2001 z0 with COARE 3.0 zt/zq. Every non-zero identity also adds the AHW dissipative-heating term rho*ustm^2*wspdi to HFX over water (module_sf_mynn.F:1067-1072), which is the third and least obvious thing isftcflx selects. Land keeps Zilitinkevich (1995) and snow keeps Andreas (2002); isftcflx is not read on land at all. isftcflx=4 is REFUSED, not unported: :644 sets a z0 and :680-702 has no arm for it, so WRF reads its local z_t/z_q uninitialized and there is no defined behaviour to match. COARE 3.5 (edson_etal_2013, fairall_etal_2014) is transcribed and pinned at its own entry points but unreachable from the column solver under the compiled-in COARE_OPT=3.0 at :85, so it stays out of the selector. Unported: iz0tlnd 1 (Czil_new), 2 (Yang_2008) and 3 (garratt_1992 land arm at its :743 call site) -- all land identities.

revised-mm5.label: Revised MM5 surface layer (Jimenez, WRF option 1)

temf.label: TEMF surface layer
warnings: Native WRF v4.6.1 real-run input replay under strict numerics: PBL 0/7136 differing words; surface layer 0/160. Native PBL arithmetic and the upper mass-flux recurrence are retained. The surface zero-moisture limit is declared separately. Observation-based forecast skill is not established.

refused_when.reason: diff_opt=1 (WRF coordinate-surface diffusion) is implemented for km_opt=2 and 4, which supply its exchange coefficients; km_opt=0 does not, so the run would carry no coordinate operator
refused_when.remedy_label: Set diff_opt=2 for the metric operator this closure runs.

refused_when.reason: topo_wind acts only through the surface drag of the PBL schemes that read CTOPO/CTOPO2, YSU (bl_pbl_physics=1) and Shin-Hong (bl_pbl_physics=11); any other PBL does not consume the coefficients, so the run would name a terrain-wind correction without applying one

closure-supplied.label: no km_opt operator (closure-supplied mixing)

evidence_axes.conformance_implies_scientific_validatio: Agreement with WRF is agreement with a model. No rung of the conformance ladder implies any value on the scientific axis, and the two are reported separately everywhere.

absent_surfaces.contract: A ratified nest edge carries no maturity key. The absence is the contract, not an omission: the edge was ratified as a whole against its per-species receipt, so there is no separate conformance rung to report for it. An unratified edge carries 'experimental-runtime' and warns.

experimental-runtime.definition: Executable, and carrying a documented runtime restriction or an unratified composition -- a table-bound runtime, or a nest edge between two microphysics schemes. Selecting it warns and does not block.

implemented-unverified.definition: A GPUWM runtime component executes this option and no matched ArWen-versus-WRF forecast trajectory has been run with it. Selecting it warns and does not block.

planned.definition: Registered so the roadmap is readable. No GPUWM runtime component exists, implemented is false, and the option cannot be selected.

supported.definition: Agreement with the WRF reference implementation is settled for this option by committed oracle parity or an equivalent comparison, and it carries no runtime restriction. Selecting it does not warn.

wrf-matched-run.definition: A historical matched-run label. Read verification_scope and its note: the current code or exact suite may not be covered, and some template labels are composition exemptions. This is code verification against WRF. It is not validation against observations.

wrf-matched-run-candidate.definition: Executable and gated, with a ratified reference comparison, and deliberately not the default: the next candidate for a full matched run. Selecting it warns and does not block.

absent_surfaces.contract: Templates carry no scientific_evidence. A template is a composition of options and inherits no independent evidence by being composed; read the axis on the options it selects.
A nest edge carries no scientific_evidence for the same reason.

scientific.catalogue_contract: An option is promoted off 'none' only by an entry in scientific_evidence_catalogue naming the artifact and quoting its category basis. Every option in this registry reads 'none': their evidence is conformance, which lives on the other axis.

conservation-gated.definition: Carries a committed conservation residual gate over an idealized problem.

converged-numerical-reference.definition: Compared against a converged high-resolution numerical reference solution of an idealized problem.

idealized-analytic.definition: Compared against a closed-form or analytically constrained solution of an idealized problem.

none.definition: No independent scientific evidence is claimed for this option. Its evidence is conformance with the WRF reference implementation, which lives on the other axis.

obs-evaluated.definition: Evaluated against observations. No option in this registry carries this value; the rung exists so the absence is visible rather than unrepresentable.

C1.name: trajectory pointer
C1.statement: A template whose maturity is at or above 'wrf-matched-run-candidate' carries an evidence_pointer that resolves to a matched-run manifest under gpuwm/authorities/matched_runs/.

C2.name: composition ceiling
C2.statement: A template's maturity rank does not exceed the lowest maturity rank among the component options it selects. A composed suite is only as conformant as its weakest member.

morrison-mp10-ysu-mm5-noah-kf-rte-rrtmgp.basis: The Morrison reference campaign matched the whole suite against WRF, and no matched-run manifest for it has been assembled yet. Noah and YSU are 'implemented-unverified': neither has its own matched ArWen-versus-WRF forecast trajectory, so the strict-min ceiling for every suite selecting them is 'implemented-unverified'.

nssl2-mp18-ysu-mm5-noah-kf-rrtmg-legacy-.basis: The legacy-RRTMG sibling of the entry above, granted on the same basis.

nssl2-mp18-ysu-mm5-noah-kf-rte-rrtmgp-wr.basis: NSSL-2 has fused-process oracles and a ratified 500 m comparison, and no matched-run manifest. Noah and YSU are 'implemented-unverified': neither has its own matched ArWen-versus-WRF forecast trajectory, so the strict-min ceiling for every suite selecting them is 'implemented-unverified'.

thompson-mp8-shinhong-mm5-noah-rrtmg-leg.basis: The gray-zone sibling of the entry above -- the same composition with Shin-Hong 2015 in place of YSU -- granted on the same basis, with the same payer: this composition's first stock-WRF-paired t0/case receipt. Shin-Hong's own port is measured bitwise against the byte-frozen WRF v4.6.1 module on both halves (max ULP 0 on the float32 CPU authority; 0 ULP on the CUDA heat tendency), which is conformance evidence and not a matched forecast trajectory. Noah and Shin-Hong are 'implemented-unverified': neither has its own matched ArWen-versus-WRF forecast trajectory, so the strict-min ceiling for this suite is 'implemented-unverified'.

thompson-mp8-ysu-mm5-noah-dudhia-daytime.basis: A table-bound experimental runtime carried above its component floor. Noah and YSU are 'implemented-unverified': neither has its own matched ArWen-versus-WRF forecast trajectory, so the strict-min ceiling for every suite selecting them is 'implemented-unverified'.

thompson-mp8-ysu-mm5-noah-kf-rte-rrtmgp-.basis: The default template selects the substitution radiation engine, and the matched run of record was produced with the exact legacy engine, so its manifest does not cover this template's tuple. Noah and YSU are 'implemented-unverified': neither has its own matched ArWen-versus-WRF forecast trajectory, so the strict-min ceiling for every suite selecting them is 'implemented-unverified'.

thompson-mp8-ysu-mm5-noah-rrtmg-legacy-v.basis: The observation battery's registered composition (lead ruling, obs-battery integration wave 2026-08-04): Thompson mp8 is wrf-matched-run and the legacy RRTMG engine is the certified WRF v4.6.1 port, but no receipt covers the composed suite yet -- the battery shakedown case's stock-WRF-paired t0/case receipt is the named payer. Noah and YSU are 'implemented-unverified': neither has its own matched ArWen-versus-WRF forecast trajectory, so the strict-min ceiling for every suite selecting them is 'implemented-unverified'.

wsm6-ysu-mm5-noah-no-radiation-v1.basis: The reference no-radiation suite is 'supported' on its own oracle parity. Noah and YSU are 'implemented-unverified': neither has its own matched ArWen-versus-WRF forecast trajectory, so the strict-min ceiling for every suite selecting them is 'implemented-unverified'.

composition_rule.discharge: A clause is discharged for a template either by a resolvable evidence_pointer -- a whole-suite matched run outranks a component-wise minimum, because the suite itself was compared -- or by an entry in composition_exemptions naming the owner-decision id that granted it. Nothing is discharged silently.

wrf_461 conserves water and reconstructs heat with mixed condensate. gsd_41 reproduces the source's pre-mixing condensate heat and tendency-only negative-condensate clipping together. This defect form is never an importer or recipe default.
true takes the gsd_41 option-2 mixing length's TKE conversion 0.5*q as written (no square); false, the default, takes 0.5*q**2 as its option 1 and every later generation do.
Advects QKE_ADV through the scalar RK transport and copies it into and out of MYNN.

Selects the MYNN generation. wrf_461 is WRF v4.6.1 module_bl_mynn.F. gsd_41 is the GSD MYNN v4.1 of the NOAA-EMC WRF 3.9 branch, ported row by row: a downward surface vapour flux (dew, frost) reaches the vapour equation instead of being deleted, and mixing length option 2 takes that generation's constants, caps and blend. A namelist that spells the budget switch bl_mynn_tkebudget (WRF 3.x) imports as gsd_41.

brcr_ub.unimplemented_reason: Not a WRF v4.6.1 namelist option. BRCR_UB is a YSU scheme-internal constant compiled into the existing kernel, so there is no legal WRF user setting to expose.

cam_abs_freq_s.description: WRF CAM absorption/emissivity refresh interval in seconds. Zero refreshes at every radiation call; retained absorption arrays and their clock belong to the radiation checkpoint.

warnings: 0 (the Registry default) is the 16-member ensemble mean, compared bitwise against WRF v4.6.1. 1..16 run one closure member of cup_forcing_ens_3d alone: WRF's own code path, implemented but not verified against a WRF run.
Read only when either radiation selector is 99. CONRAD (0) requires a transmission table matched to the vertical grid; CO2O3 (1) builds it on the GPU.

cu_rad_feedback.unimplemented_reason: KF radiation feedback needs persistent convective cloud fraction, condensate-path profiles, cadence ownership, restart state, and a radiation-driver merge; the ported KF contract returns none of those profiles.

cu_used.unimplemented_reason: Not a WRF v4.6.1 namelist option. CU_USED is derived by WRF from the selected cumulus scheme and domain state, not legally set by a user.

warnings: WRF &time_control cycling. true keeps the start's QKE (unless its lowest-level maximum is below 0.0002), QC_BL and CLDFRA_BL at the first MYNN call, as the operational WRF 3.9 fork does. Refused with the v4.6.1 MYNN, whose cycled start zeroes them.
Read only under diff_6th_form = noaa_wrf39 (null takes the fork's 0.04); refused under wrf_461, which has no second factor.

Selects which source's sixth-order filter runs when diff_6th_opt > 0. wrf_461 (WRF v4.6.1) filters moisture and scalars with diff_6th_factor on the RK3 first-stage step dt/3 and stops three points short of a specified or nested edge. noaa_wrf39 (the NOAA-EMC WRFV3.9 fork, operational HRRR v4.1.21) filters the moist and scalar arrays with diff_6th_factor2 on the full step and runs the filter to the domain edge on zero-gradient halo copies; at HRRR's 0.12/0.04 that is nine times weaker on moisture. An imported namelist that names diff_6th_factor2 selects noaa_wrf39.

dust_emis.unimplemented_reason: Dust emission outside WRF-Chem feeds the ice-friendly aerosol surface source. gpuwm allocates nifa2d and leaves it exactly zero, matching thompson_init, and carries no dust inventory, emission operator, or surface-flux coupling for it.

warnings: DIVERGENCE from WRF's default 1: gpuwm defaults feedback to 0 to preserve every assembled one-way trajectory. feedback=1 is experimental; the native gpuwm run multi-domain executor and the prepared-tree executor, the native HRRR route's included, both run it.

No consumer at any value.  share/module_soil_pre.F:2063 reads this inside init_soil_ruc, i.e. in real.exe, to adjust a RUC soil state derived from a Noah one -- and gpuwm has no RUC soil ingest for it to adjust, because gpuwm/ingest/soil_contract.py targets Noah's four-layer geometry only.  Only 0 is honoured.  gpuwm/config.py validate_run_config refuses any other value before a run starts, and gpuwm/core/ruc_runtime.py ruc_lsm_step refuses it again at the seam that would have had to implement the branch, so the knob is never accepted-and-ignored.  The nonzero value is declared type-legal only so a plan that asks for it is rejected by the land-surface option that forbids it rather than by the type spec.

fractional_seaice=1 is implemented by the RUC LSM (sf_surface_physics=3) only and refused under any other land surface. It lowers the sea-ice threshold from 0.5 to 0.02 (WRF module_surface_driver.F:1365-1368), so every water cell with 0.02 <= XICE <= 1 takes the ice column, the open-water second surface-layer call and the post-LSM flux blend, and land-use initialisation and the CLM lake read the same threshold. 0 keeps the 0.5 threshold every earlier RUC run used; the blend machinery runs under both values.

grav_settling.unimplemented_reason: Gravitational settling of fog droplets is a PBL-side operator gpuwm has not ported. WRF SILENTLY forces this to 0 on every mp_physics=28 domain, at debug verbosity (share/module_check_a_mundo.F:2459-2474); gpuwm's posture is to refuse where WRF overwrites, so a nonzero value is an error.

icloud_cu.unimplemented_reason: Not a WRF v4.6.1 namelist option. ICLOUD_CU is derived cloud-state routing inside WRF's cumulus/radiation drivers, not a user knob.

warnings: Read only by the slab scheme (sf_surface_physics=1): 1 caps the skin and the top soil layer at 273.16 K under snow cover, 0 does not. For every nonzero value the default caps the top layer and skin together. GPUWM_WRF_EXACT=1 retains WRF's IFSNOW.EQ.1 top-layer cap, which leaves a measured 16 K skin/soil split at IFSNOW=2.

kf_edrates.unimplemented_reason: The KF entrainment/detrainment diagnostic output subsystem is absent: the ported kernel does not return the rate profiles and gpuwm has no carriers, restart identity, or wrfout variables for them.

kfeta_trigger.unimplemented_reason: This is an option branch inside the already ported KF scheme, but the alternate trigger paths and their moisture-advective-tendency input are not transcribed into the KF kernel/driver or oracle fixtures.

warnings: tmn_update=1 requires lagday=150, WRF share/module_check_a_mundo.F:2306-2312
Minimum water-cell elevation in metres used by WRF when the input does not provide a lake mask.
Depth in metres used by WRF lakeini when a supplied depth is nonpositive or use_lakedepth=0. A nonpositive default uses WRF's reference layer geometry depth.

mix_full_fields.description: WRF logical retained under coordinate diffusion; that operator always mixes theta relative to its initial field.

warnings: moist_mix6_off = true removes the 6th-order horizontal filter from the WRF moist array only (dyn_em/module_em.F:1421 under config_flags%moist_mix6_off); theta keeps its filter and the number/volume tracers keep theirs, which is WRF's own per-array scoping, not a gpuwm simplification.

This is divergence-ledger entry L4 and it is UNDECIDED: it is a candidate ArWen default with no obs-skill receipt yet. Selecting it through the [experiment] physics_mode axis (gpuwm/physics_mode.py) records the arm in the run receipt; setting it by hand here does not, and a hand-set value beside physics_mode is refused rather than merged.
RUC weighted vegetation parameters and irrigation use LANDUSEF. WRF's default is 0; 1 requires category fractions.
RUC weighted soil parameters use SOILCTOP. WRF's default is 0; 1 requires category fractions.

Read only with sf_surface_mosaic = 1 and sf_urban_physics = 1. dominant is WRF v4.7.1: the urban canopy runs only where a cell's dominant category is urban. every_tile also runs the urban tiles of a mostly rural cell at their own land-use weights, sharing the largest urban tile type's URBPARM urban fraction, a gpuwm option WRF does not have; the 10 m wind override stays on dominant-urban cells.
After microphysics: 1 sets non-vapour species below mp_zero_out_thresh to zero, 2 also floors vapour at zero; the outermost ring is floored at zero in both (WRF module_microphysics_zero_out).
1 also applies mp_zero_out to the scalar number arrays, which the NOAA WRFV3.9 fork always does; WRF v4.6.1's default 0 applies it to the moist array only.

Selects the generation of the MYNN surface layer. wrf_461 is WRF v4.6.1 module_sf_mynn.F. gsl_wrf39 is the same module in the GSL WRF 3.9 fork (NOAA-EMC/HRRR v4.1.21): z/L from a 5-pass secant search that gives up to 5 Ri (unstable) or 8 Ri (stable), z/L capped at 50 instead of 20, the bulk Richardson number clamped at 50 instead of 4 after the first step, zt instead of z0 in the heat log numerators, and z0/L instead of zt/L as psih's lower limit at the first level. Over rough land (forest, urban) on stable nights the two give different u* and exchange coefficients.

naer.unimplemented_reason: NAER seeds WRF's naer-based droplet mode inside classic Thompson (thompson-mp8), which is a fixed-droplet port. The prognostic aerosol path lives in components.microphysics.options.thompson-aerosol-mp28, whose nc/nwfa/nifa come from CCN activation rather than from this scalar, so honouring it here would be a different scheme.

warnings: Snow-aging call placement only. wrf_470 moves SNOW_AGE and SNOW_AGE_GLACIER before the solar branch, as WRF v4.7.0 and v4.7.1 do. wrf_461 preserves daylight-only aging. Neither selects the complete Noah-MP 5.1.2 model. A flip is refused on restart because TAUSS and the following dawn's BATS albedo would change.

nssl_2moment_on.evidence: Column smoke over the four ported variant modes on the shipped run_nssl2_production_step seam (tools/nssl2_variant_probe.py, evidence/nssl2-variants/variant-column-smoke.json), in two regimes: the seeded moist column behind the mp18 digest baseline, and a riming-updraft regime built to put the graupel-to-hail conversion in range. Each variant is compared against the DEFAULT mode run on THE SAME inputs, so a delta is a treatment and not an input difference. Asserted: every output array finite; the fields a variant's Registry packages would not allocate stay exactly 0.0; the CCN field comes back byte-identical to its input when the variant does not predict it; and every variant moves at least one field against its control (the hail arms move 29 and 30 fields in the riming regime and legitimately move none in the moist column, where the conversion never fires). The shipped mp18 default lane is unchanged by all of this: all 30 digests in evidence/nssl2-variants/mp18-digest-baseline.json reproduce byte-for-byte. NO ORACLE COMPARISON AGAINST WRF FORTRAN EXISTS FOR ANY VARIANT PATH -- no WRF run, no matched trajectory, no ULP measurement. The oracle campaign is the declared next stage, as it was for Shin-Hong and Grell-Freitas.
nssl_2moment_on.note: WRF's nssl_2moment_on (Registry.EM_COMMON:2423). -1 takes WRF's consistency-pass default of 1 (module_check_a_mundo.F:3437-3439). 0 selects the one-moment NSSL family (the deprecated mp_physics=19/21 spellings), which is NOT ported and is refused at validation rather than substituted.

nssl_3moment.unimplemented_reason: The NSSL three-moment extension (nssl_3moment=1, which WRF rewrites to 2 with hail on at module_check_a_mundo.F:3457-3463) adds the qzr/qzg/qzh reflectivity moments and the ipconc>=6 branch throughout the scheme. The ported family is the two-moment ipconc=5 branch only; gpuwm/core/nssl2_contract.py refuses the combination at validation.

nssl_alphah.unimplemented_reason: The hail gamma-shape option is a bounded branch in the already ported NSSL scheme, but its value is still compiled into coefficient setup and is not carried through RunConfig, kernel arguments, or independent WRF oracle fixtures.

nssl_alphahl.unimplemented_reason: The large-hail gamma-shape option is a bounded NSSL coefficient branch, but config plumbing, device coefficient regeneration, and two-value WRF oracle fixtures are absent.

nssl_alphar.unimplemented_reason: Not a WRF v4.6.1 namelist option. NSSL_ALPHAR is a scheme-internal rain-shape constant and has no legal user setting.

nssl_cccn.unimplemented_reason: The initial CCN concentration is a bounded NSSL setup value, but gpuwm hardwires QNN cold-start initialization and has no RunConfig/restart-bound path or two-value WRF initialization oracle.

nssl_icdx.unimplemented_reason: The NSSL ice-distribution selector is a bounded coefficient branch inside the ported scheme, but the alternate initialization/table path is not transcribed or oracle-tested and has no config plumbing.

nssl_icdxhl.unimplemented_reason: The NSSL large-hail distribution selector is a bounded coefficient branch, but its alternate table/setup path, device plumbing, and two-value WRF oracle are absent.

num_land_cat.unimplemented_reason: WRF derives this count from the selected land-use dataset/table. Supporting another value requires alternate static categories, parameter tables, field validation, and state dimensions; it is not an independent runtime tune in gpuwm.

num_soil_cat.unimplemented_reason: WRF derives this count from the selected soil-category dataset/table. Arbitrary values require alternate static categories, parameter tables, validation, and allocations rather than a scalar branch.

warnings: The resolved layer count comes from the SCHEME, not from this knob: gpuwm/config.py soil_layer_count consults LAND_SURFACE_SOIL_LAYERS for the selected sf_surface_physics, so Noah and Noah-MP resolve 4 and RUC resolves the 6 or 9 it was asked for, and every soil allocation, VRAM count, output dimension and restart shape reads that resolver. DIVERGENCE from WRF, deliberate: set_physics_rconfigs OVERWRITES a namelist request that disagrees with the scheme and only logs it at debug level, so a namelist asking Noah for nine layers runs on four with no error; gpuwm refuses instead. This ENUM declares every count a registered land-surface scheme defines -- 4 with Noah or Noah-MP, 6 or 9 with RUC -- and is derived from those schemes' own tables; it states what is SELECTABLE, and the separate question of what an oracle has judged is answered by this warning and by the run receipt, never by the enum. WRF's six-level RUC grid (share/module_soil_pre.F:init_soil_depth_3) is one of those counts, and it COMPILES and RUNS: gpuwm/core/kernels/ruc.cu sizes every soil scratch from RUC_NZS and selects its level table with it, gpuwm.core.ruc/.ruc_gpu resolve the count from the profile, and a 1-hour HRRR-initialised forecast completes at six levels with soil_layers_stag=6 in its wrfout. What six LACKS is a WRF FORECAST ORACLE -- every lsmruc/sfctmp/soilmoist/snowtemp fixture in the tree is nine-level -- so it is a MATURITY statement, not an admission question: it is selected through the hash-bound experiment config (sf_surface_physics = 3 with num_soil_layers = 6) rather than a named --physics-profile, warns at runtime, and carries soil_geometry_evidence=internal-consistency-only in its run receipt. See docs/wrf_ruc_runtime_admission.md.

num_wif_levels.unimplemented_reason: This sizes the WIF (water/ice-friendly aerosol) metgrid input stream. The WRF namelist importer accepts the monthly WIF dataset's 30 levels with use_aero_icbc=true and wif_input_opt=1; the native configuration does not expose an independent level-count override.

warnings: o3input=0 is implemented only by ra_rrtmg_variant='rrtmg_legacy', where the WRF wrapper constructs O3DATA. RTE+RRTMGP admits only 2.

ocean_mld_climatology.description: Named MLD fallback when no ocean analysis or explicit profiles are supplied; NOAA WOA18 monthly density MLD is the default.

warnings: Maximum PWP substep in minutes, as used by WRF DPWP; surface intervals are fully subcycled.
Deep-water lapse rate below the mixed layer in K/m (WRF default 0.14); must be positive.
Initial mixed-layer depth in metres (WRF default 50). 0 or less reads a 2-D H0ML from the input file.
Relaxation time in seconds back to the initial mixed-layer state; 0 (WRF default) means none.

progn.unimplemented_reason: PROGN switches classic Thompson (thompson-mp8) onto WRF's chemistry-driven droplet source, which needs a QNDROPSOURCE carrier gpuwm has no writer for. Prognostic droplet number itself IS ported, as components.microphysics.options.thompson-aerosol-mp28 (mp_physics=28), where it is driven by CCN activation instead.

qna_update.unimplemented_reason: Updating aerosol number from a wrfqnainp auxiliary stream needs an auxiliary input subsystem, an update cadence, restart position and field ownership; gpuwm writes one fixed wrfout frame per domain and reads no auxiliary input streams at all.

warnings: rdlai2d=true is implemented by Noah (sf_surface_physics=2) and RUC (sf_surface_physics=3): the LSM keeps the LAI12M field interpolated to the start date instead of the VEGPARM table value. Under RUC a road that seeds no LAI field is refused at the first land-surface step rather than running the allocation default.
rdmaxalb=false is implemented only by Noah LSM (sf_surface_physics=2), whose LSMINIT replaces supplied SNOALB with VEGPARM MAXALB by vegetation category.

rrtmg_aer3_type_source.description: Aerosol type of the aer_opt=3 shortwave optics: rural type 1 everywhere (the NOAA WRFV3.9 HRRR fork) or the NOAA MPAS fork's land/water type, rural over land and maritime over water.

rrtmg_cloud_optics_form.description: Source form of the legacy RRTMG cloud wrapper: WRF v4.6.1 or the NOAA WRFV3.9 fork's shortwave radius defaults, snow ice fraction and Thompson cold-start radii.

rrtmg_smoke_manifest.description: Explicit timestamped three-dimensional prescribed smoke forcing. Empty selects no prescribed smoke; enabled requires legacy shortwave, aer_opt=3 and aerosol-aware Thompson. Manifest and member content identities bind forecasts and restarts.

warnings: How SFCDIAGS_RUCLSM writes T2, TH2 and Q2. flux (public WRF) is the flux form. log_profile adds the block the operational RAP/HRRR branch carries and no public WRF has: where the air is warmer or moister than the surface, T2 and Q2 follow a logarithmic profile between the surface and half the lowest layer. Measured on a 3 km cut of an operational-HRRR start at night: T2 0.33 to 0.36 K lower, 2 m dewpoint 0.01 K lower, against the operational model's own files, which match the flux form's T2 within 0.04 K. Default flux.

Selects which WRF lineage's LSMRUC irrigation holds root-layer soil moisture up after SFCTMP. wrf_45 (WRF v4.0-4.5, also the operational RAP/HRRR branch) is a hard floor scaled by the cell's cropland fraction and gated on leaf area index above 1.1 (cropland) or 0.7 (dominant crop/natural mosaic), applied whatever mosaic_lu says: with mosaic_lu=1 it reads the LANDUSEF fractions, with mosaic_lu=0 the dominant category counts as the whole cell. wrf_461 (WRF v4.6.1, mosaic_lu=1 only) relaxes every root layer toward the full 1.1 x wilting point each step for any cell with any crop or crop/natural fraction and a greenness factor above 0.75. The generic default remains wrf_461. The operational namelist importer and HRRR configuration recipe explicitly select wrf_45, which changes the added irrigation water.

LSMRUC's cold start of the ground vapour and condensate when the run starts without them. wrf (public WRF, the default) starts QCG from the lowest-level condensate and QVG from saturation at the skin times moisture availability. air (the operational RAP/HRRR branch's fallback; that branch cycles QVG) starts an invalid QVG from the lowest-level vapour with no ground condensate. Because SOILTEMP carries the old QVG as vapour storage, air pulls the skin toward the air's dewpoint on the first steps: measured 2.7 K colder after 20 steps on a moist test column, and -0.013 to +0.018 K of 2 m dewpoint on a 3 km cut of an operational-HRRR start. Read only on a cold start.

Which WRF lineage's RUC snow scheme runs. wrf_45 (WRF v4.0-4.5, which the operational RAP/HRRR branch carries) takes a constant snow conductivity, snow cover from depth over a critical depth taken after compaction, fresh-snow albedo from the depth on the ground, a melt cap independent of the step, melt bookkeeping scaled by cover under the snow mosaic, and SNOWFALLAC grown by new snow less its melt. wrf_461 (WRF v4.6.1) takes the Sturm conductivity, the blended depth and roughness cover rebuilt after the snow column, and density-gated melt limits. The generic default remains wrf_461. The operational namelist importer and HRRR configuration recipe explicitly select wrf_45, which changes answers where there is snow.

Selects which WRF lineage's LSMRUC SOILPROP sets soil-water diffusivity and hydraulic conductivity. wrf_45 (WRF v4.0-4.5, also the operational RAP/HRRR branch) normalises both by the moisture above the residual, (theta - qmin)/(theta_sat - qmin), and uses mineral conductivity 2.0 at every quartz fraction. wrf_461 (WRF v4.6.1) uses total moisture over porosity and 3.0 below 20 percent quartz; in dry soil its water diffusivity is 2.5 to 8 times larger, measured to raise a 3 km afternoon top soil level from 0.161 to 0.187 m3/m3 in one hour from the levels below, where the operational model's own top level fell to 0.157. The default changed from the v4.6.1 form to wrf_45: every RUC configuration changes answers.

scalar_pblmix.description: WRF post-PBL diff4d of the mp=28 nc/ni/nwfa/nifa scalars on the selected scheme's lower-interface EXCH_H (consumer row scalar_diffusion_exchange). No PBL and SASE are declared no-ops.

scm_force_flux.unimplemented_reason: This belongs to WRF's single-column-model forcing subsystem; gpuwm has no SCM runner, forcing time series, column boundary contract, or restart semantics.

warnings: A nondefault seaice_albedo_default is implemented only by RUC LSM (sf_surface_physics=3), in the live sea-ice ALBBCK override before LSMRUC.

seaice_albedo_opt.unimplemented_reason: The option is consumed by WRF's separate Noah sea-ice thermodynamics driver (including the Mills branch and optional ALBSI field); that driver and field are absent, so the RUC ALBBCK override is not a substitute.

warnings: Uniform initial ice thickness prior in metres unless an input thickness field is supplied; not an observation.
New-ice thickness in metres used for thermodynamic concentration growth.
Prescribed basal ocean-to-ice heat flux in W m-2; no ocean circulation or seasonal skill is implied.
Prognostic thermodynamic ice and snow on non-lake ocean cells, activated when initial ocean ice is present. False selects prescribed sea ice.

seaice_snowdepth_max.unimplemented_reason: This bound is consumed only by the absent Noah sea-ice thermodynamics driver; gpuwm has no sea-ice snow-depth state or surface-driver call on which it could act.

seaice_snowdepth_min.unimplemented_reason: This bound is consumed only by the absent Noah sea-ice thermodynamics driver; gpuwm has no sea-ice snow-depth state or surface-driver call on which it could act.

seaice_snowdepth_opt.unimplemented_reason: The selector belongs to the absent Noah sea-ice thermodynamics driver and its optional SNOWSI input; no such state, ingest, restart, or kernel contract exists.

seaice_thickness_default.unimplemented_reason: WRF consumes this in the absent Noah sea-ice thermodynamics driver when seaice_thickness_opt=0. The unrelated 3 m cold-start soil interpolation literal is not this knob and cannot honor it.

seaice_thickness_opt.unimplemented_reason: The selector belongs to the absent Noah sea-ice thermodynamics driver; option 1 additionally requires ICEDEPTH ingest/state/restart carriers that gpuwm does not have.

warnings: Read at initialization: real.exe's adjust_for_seaice_pre (slab) or adjust_for_seaice_post (Noah, RUC, Noah-MP) converts open water below this skin temperature to ice. The default 100 K converts nothing.
Option 1 runs WRF's CLM lake column on LAKEMASK cells, with ten water and ten sediment layers and up to five snow layers. Default 0 retains prescribed water temperatures.

Option 1 runs WRF Pollard OML1D; option 2 runs CUDA 3DPWP circulation and vertical mixing with prognostic temperature, salinity and currents. Both couple SST to TSK every surface step. An absent ocean analysis is a loudly labelled configured uniform MLD fallback. Full TC and observation qualification is pending.

Noah only: WRF v4.7.1 lsm_mosaic tile state. Stock-WRF export of mosaic land state and moving-nest tile interpolation are not reproduced. Urban option 1 runs inside the tile loop, by default only where a cell's dominant category is urban (mosaic_urban_canopy); mosaic option cannot work with urban options 2 and 3 (WRF module_check_a_mundo.F:505-518).
WOOF extension to the ARW namelist vocabulary: CU_SAS defaults to 1, while 0 disables its shallow branch.

shalwater_depth.unimplemented_reason: The shallow-water surface branch needs a bathymetry/depth static field and its surface coupling; gpuwm ingests neither and has no runtime branch to consume the scalar.

shalwater_z0.unimplemented_reason: The shallow-water roughness branch needs the missing shallow-water/bathymetry classification and surface-driver coupling; setting a scalar alone would be inert.

shcu_physics.unimplemented_reason: This selects independent shallow-cumulus schemes. No shallow-cumulus component, tendencies, cadence state, restart contract, or radiation coupling is ported.

warnings: 0 is no smoothing, 1 is WRF's sm121 and 2 is smdsm. Prepared hierarchy artifacts are the same at every value: this smooths the parent after feedback while the tree runs and does nothing to a prepared child.
wrf_480 uses WRF 4.8 calc_coszen: julian minus 0.5, coefficient 0.040849. wrf_461 retains julian minus 1 and coefficient 0.04089 for reproduction. A change refuses an incompatible restart.
spp_conv=1 requires GF closure and a member-owned stochastic pattern bound by the ensemble timestep provider. The provider owns the spectral restart state.

spp_lsm=1 consumes a member-owned stochastic pattern in RUC's historical WRF 3.9.1 hydraulic-conductivity operator. Current WRF 4.6.1 and 4.7.1 retain the arguments but omit this operator. The ensemble provider owns its spectral restart state; ordinary physics refuses an enabled consumer without a bound pattern.
spp_pbl=1 requires MYNN PBL and surface and a member-owned stochastic pattern bound by the ensemble timestep provider. The provider owns the spectral restart state.

sst_skin.description: WRF 4.6.1 skin SST adjustment; carries SSTSK (K) and DTW (C), writes TSK over water

warnings: 1 reads Rust-prepared stream-4 SST, SEAICE, VEGFRA and ALBBCK by valid time; CUDA applies WRF surface and soil resets on water/ice transitions.
Path to the Rust surface-analysis manifest. Missing source cells preserve the initial or previously valid analysis.

surface_input_source.unimplemented_reason: Alternate surface-input sources require source-specific static/met-field selection and provenance semantics. gpuwm's ingest routes own those choices explicitly and implement no interchangeable runtime source selector.

warnings: wrf_39_noaa selects the fork's singular melting-snow fall speed. It is a defined fork defect and defaults off. blend retains the later rain-share blend.

wrf_39_noaa uses the NOAA WRF 3.9 fork's size distributions and its own pinned tables. Fork column comparisons are in tests/test_thompson_wrf39.py; the v4.6.1 qualification receipts do not qualify this generation.

tice2tsk_if2cold.unimplemented_reason: This is a bounded branch in the existing fractional-sea-ice surface wrapper, but gpuwm currently transcribes only the false arithmetic (the operational HRRR v4.1.21 value). The true get_local_ice_tsk branch, TSK_ICE = MIN(TSK, 273.15), is not ported and has no WRF oracle fixture.

ua_phys.unimplemented_reason: Noah unified-atmosphere coupling is a separate physics path with additional state and feedback semantics; gpuwm ports the ordinary Noah LSM driver only.

upper_wind_limiter_form.description: WRF v4.6.1 has no upper-wind limiter. The NOAA WRFV3.9 form damps saved stage winds above 110 m/s inside zdamp on each acoustic substep when damp_opt=3. A namelist naming diff_6th_factor2 selects the fork form.

warnings: Explicit URBPARM entries replace the pinned release table and their decoded coefficient words bind restart. Empty retains the generation's pinned bundled tables.
wrf_480 selects WRF v4.8.0 ground vegetation, tree shading and canopy flux feedback with declared defined entry memory; changing generation refuses restart.

wrf_480 removes the three rain-positive impervious-store clamps so evaporation may exceed weak rainfall. wrf_471 reproduces the older clamps. Both retain rho_air/1000. This selects water balance only, not WRF 4.8 vegetation or trees. A generation change refuses an SLUCM restart.

use_aero_icbc.unimplemented_reason: For components.microphysics.options.thompson-aerosol-mp28, this namelist-only key imports through the aer_init_opt=1 / wif_input_opt=1 pair rather than a RunConfig field of its own. Monthly WIF and analyzed QNWFA/QNIFA initial and lateral carriers are implemented. An unrestricted GOCART species reader is not.

warnings: WRF default 1 requires input LAKE_DEPTH. Explicit 0 uses lakedepth_default for every lake column.
use_mp_re=0 is implemented only by ra_rrtmg_variant='rrtmg_legacy'; it disables the WRF microphysics effective-radius scheme table and makes the wrapper calculate radii.

use_rap_aero_icbc.description: Analyzed QNWFA/QNIFA initial and lateral values with operational monthly surface emissions; mp_physics=28 only.

use_theta_m.description: Thermal prognostic: dry potential temperature (0) or moist potential temperature (1); history T stays dry and THM carries moist theta.

warnings: usemonalb=true is implemented by Noah (sf_surface_physics=2) and RUC (sf_surface_physics=3): landuse_init keeps real.exe's ALBEDO12M background albedo interpolated to the start date instead of LANDUSE.TBL's seasonal row, and a snow-covered cell takes SNOALB. A surface source without the monthly albedo field is refused by name.

wif_fire_emit.unimplemented_reason: Biomass-burning aerosol emissions for Thompson-MP-Aero need a fire inventory, an emission cadence and the derived aer_fire_emit_opt state WRF computes from this flag; gpuwm carries none of them.

wif_fire_inj.unimplemented_reason: This selects the vertical injection profile for the biomass-burning aerosol emissions above. It is a branch inside a subsystem gpuwm does not have, so there is nothing for it to distribute.

warnings: wrf_480 is the corrected default: WRF 4.8 pinned MMM 550b5b4 removes the 0.2 offset and caps top-down entrainment efficiency at 0.4. wrf_461 under default arithmetic reproduces 2.8.9's YSU kernel (kernels/ysu_default.cu) under its restart identity; under GPUWM_WRF_EXACT=1 it is unmodified WRF 4.6.1 bl_ysu_run word for word, under its own restart identity. Changing generation changes tendencies and is refused on restart.

For zadvect_implicit_variant='wrf_471', DIVERGENCE from WRF v4.7.1, declared: the implicit w solve's two boundary terms take the units of the w terms beside them. WRF's lower boundary (dyn_em/module_ieva_em.F:1231-1244) builds the surface w increment from the mass-coupled u/v tendencies, about one column mass too large, and a steep-ridge run went NaN in three steps; gpuwm uncouples each tendency by its map factor and face column mass first. WRF's upper boundary (:1248-1253) leaves the geopotential change over dt undivided by g; gpuwm divides it. Every other IEVA routine matches WRF v4.7.1 word for word, and the w solve matches WRF's routine with those two corrections (tools/ieva_wrf_oracle).

Selects the WRF numerical generation when zadvect_implicit=1. wrf_471 preserves module_ieva_em. wrf_legacy uses module_advect_em's current-mass coefficients and one-sided horizontal Courant allowance. Both uncouple the lower w boundary's momentum tendencies, a declared unit correction.
