component_override_refusal_reasons.radiation: analytic-clear-sky is not a forecast radiation scheme: it computes a clear-sky flux from solar geometry alone and carries no cloud, aerosol or gas optics, so every cloudy column's heating is wrong by the whole cloud effect; this route declares ra_lw_physics and ra_sw_physics in allowed_expert_selector_keys, which is where a dycore or idealized experiment writes 90/90
component_override_refusal_reasons.urban: WRF runs one urban selector on every domain (it resets them all to the innermost domain's value, share/module_check_a_mundo.F:1063-1077); set sf_urban_physics in [shared], not per domain.

deferred_parameter_keys.clos_choice: clos_choice and ishallow are Grell-family keys, read only where cu_physics is 3 or 5; gpuwm.config refuses a nonzero value beside any other cumulus scheme. Select Grell-Freitas or Grell 3D and set them in the experiment config.
deferred_parameter_keys.cugd_avedx: cugd_avedx is Grell 3D's subsidence-spreading width, read only where cu_physics=5; gpuwm.config refuses a value other than 1 beside any other cumulus scheme. Select Grell 3D and set it in the experiment config.
deferred_parameter_keys.diff_6th_opt: diff_6th_opt=1 is non-monotonic and gpuwm.config refuses it with moist=true, because the unlimited 6th-order fluxes bypass the positive-definite transport limiter and can drive negative moisture. The coupling is to moist, not to any component, so no option row can carry it yet. Set it in the experiment config, where validate_run_config checks the pair.
deferred_parameter_keys.ishallow: clos_choice and ishallow are Grell-family keys, read only where cu_physics is 3 or 5; gpuwm.config refuses a nonzero value beside any other cumulus scheme. Select Grell-Freitas or Grell 3D and set them in the experiment config.
deferred_parameter_keys.o3input: o3input and use_mp_re are honoured only by the legacy RRTMG engine; the modern spectrum does not implement the nondefault ozone and effective-radius operations, and gpuwm.config refuses the pair. Select ra_rrtmg_variant='rrtmg_legacy' in the experiment config and set them there.
deferred_parameter_keys.ra_physics: every radiation option states ra_physics, so it spells WHICH option is selected rather than a value inside one. Select the radiation option that carries the value you want; overriding ra_physics per domain could only restate or contradict the option already chosen.
deferred_parameter_keys.ra_rrtmg_variant: the engine and the compatibility token must agree, and gpuwm.config refuses a variant that contradicts the resolved wrf_rrtmg_compatibility. A per-domain override of one without the other is exactly that contradiction, so the pair is set together in the experiment config.
deferred_parameter_keys.use_mp_re: use_mp_re is honoured only by the legacy RRTMG engine; see o3input. Set it in the experiment config beside ra_rrtmg_variant='rrtmg_legacy'.
deferred_parameter_keys.wrf_rrtmg_compatibility: the compatibility token records a 4/4 substitution and gpuwm.config refuses it unless the domain resolves the 4/4 pair. Selecting the radiation option that resolves that pair is how a domain asks for it; the token follows the option rather than varying against it.

expert_warnings: Noah-MP's whole column runs on the DEVICE as of the slab orchestration. Measured 2026-07-27, twice, on one RTX 5090: a 360,000-land-column call (d04 of the four-domain production tree) costs 0.202-0.227 s, i.e. 7.3-8.2 wall seconds per simulated minute at dt=1.667 s with bldt=0 -- against 4,982-5,977 through the retired per-column CPython solver, whose flat 7.18 ms/column and 43-minutes-per-call projection this acknowledgement was originally written around. The acknowledgement id keeps its host-era name (noahmp-host-column-throughput-v1) so existing consent records stay valid over a label, exactly as restart_identity does; what it records reading today is the measured slab cost above. What keeps this template behind an acknowledgement instead of as a peer of Noah is no longer throughput: it is that no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison exists (implemented-unverified), and graduation is a lead decision with its own validation ladder (docs/noahmp_device_column_report.md).

graph_setting_constraints.reason: the nested lateral-boundary branch carries no exponential sponge term (WRF dyn_em/module_bc_em.F:1297-1341 applies spongeweight on the SPECIFIED branch only), while gpuwm's nested Davies weights do read spec_exp -- so a nonzero value on a child applies a sponge the branch it transliterates does not have. The root of this tree may set spec_exp freely; it is externally forced and takes the specified branch.

this setting names the closure used to translate condensate ACROSS a parent-to-child edge, and the root has no parent edge to translate over. Select it on the child domain whose microphysics differs from its parent, where the transition matrix owns it.

DAYTIME-ONLY SUITE. The MYNN 5/5 suite is implemented-unverified. It is selectable because it RUNS: a 300-step coupled forecast on a stretched grid with this exact triple grows the PBL top, fills all ten carried 3-D arrays, goes non-finite nowhere, restarts bit for bit and writes the MYNN names (tests/test_mynn_pbl_runtime.py), and gpuwm/core/physics.py initialize_physics allocates every MYNN array itself, so no runner needs extra wiring. What is missing is a gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison; the component warnings carry the CUDA-versus-CPU ULP spread; the WRF FLAG_QS snow path and previous-interval radiation cloud merge are coupled.

This is the HRRR operational pairing class. WRF owns its write-back sequence explicitly: MYNN surface first, RUC flux/state write-back second, CHS and SFCDIAGS_RUCLSM last. It is offered only on routes where the established RUC template is already reachable; its nine-layer ingest and source restrictions are unchanged.

RUC is implemented-unverified and is selectable because it RUNS AT WIDTH. What is established: every routine of the column is oracle-matched against the byte-unmodified module_sf_ruclsm.F; the assembled driver is bitwise against oracle/lsmruc.csv except its 26 pinned upstream-residue cells; the CUDA column the forecast actually launches is max_ulp 0 against that host driver over all 43 returned fields at 512, 4,096 and 24,576 columns, warm and snow-covered, measured paired in one process (tests/test_ruc_device_column.py); and sf_surface_physics=3 forecasts, restarts bit for bit and writes nine-layer output (tests/test_ruc_runtime.py). What is NOT established is a gpuwm/WRF forecast-trajectory comparison, which is what validation-candidate would require. docs/wrf_ruc_runtime_admission.md is the record.

THE COST, MEASURED AT PRODUCTION WIDTH AND NOT EXTRAPOLATED. On an RTX 5090, d04 of the four-domain production case (600x600 = 360,000 columns, dt=1.667 s, bldt=0 so the land surface runs every step): 16.8 wall seconds per simulated minute on snow-free land and 65.7 on a FULLY snow-covered domain. For scale the whole four-domain MYNN stack is 27 s per simulated minute, so a snow-covered RUC d04 costs more than the rest of the model and a warm one costs less. A 12-hour d04 forecast is therefore 3.4 hours of land surface warm and 13 hours fully snow-covered. There is deliberately no column-count rail refusing wide grids the way Noah-MP has one: Noah-MP's rail exists because its call CANNOT FINISH, and RUC's d04 call is 0.47 s warm and 1.83 s over snow. The number is published here so it is read before the run, not discovered during it.

OFFERED FOR THE DIRECT hrrr AND era5 SOURCES. gfs was withdrawn in v1.1.1: a GFS-initialised RUC forecast prepares in full and then cannot take its first step, because the GFS route supplies none of the soil/surface fields RUC's land surface reads (tests/test_ruc_admission.py V-1 cases). The omission of 20crv3/mapped preparation is likewise not an oversight. gpuwm/mapped_direct.py hands the soil seam the composition's DECLARATIVE layer contract, and gpuwm/ingest/soil_contract.py validate_soil_layer_contract still declares exactly one target -- Noah's four layers -- refusing RUC's nine by name because they are a different discretization with a different value-location convention rather than a longer list of the same thing. Admitting the mapped source needs that target added and its remap proved against a WRF-real nine-level initialization, and widening the comparison would fabricate a soil column.

A RUC domain carries nine soil layers where every other gpuwm template carries four, so its restart files, its wrfout soil variables and its VRAM budget are not interchangeable with a Noah run's, and a nest tree cannot mix the two.

wsm6-mynn-mynn-ruc-no-radiation-implemen.label: WSM6 + MYNN PBL + MYNN surface layer + RUC LSM + Dudhia SW (HRRR pairing)
warnings: The MYNN 5/5 suite is implemented-unverified. This is the HRRR operational pairing class. WRF owns its write-back sequence explicitly: MYNN surface first, RUC flux/state write-back second, CHS and SFCDIAGS_RUCLSM last. It is offered only on routes where the established RUC template is already reachable; its nine-layer ingest and source restrictions are unchanged.

RUC is implemented-unverified and is selectable because it RUNS AT WIDTH. What is established: every routine of the column is oracle-matched against the byte-unmodified module_sf_ruclsm.F; the assembled driver is bitwise against oracle/lsmruc.csv except its 26 pinned upstream-residue cells; the CUDA column the forecast actually launches is max_ulp 0 against that host driver over all 43 returned fields at 512, 4,096 and 24,576 columns, warm and snow-covered, measured paired in one process (tests/test_ruc_device_column.py); and sf_surface_physics=3 forecasts, restarts bit for bit and writes nine-layer output (tests/test_ruc_runtime.py). What is NOT established is a gpuwm/WRF forecast-trajectory comparison, which is what validation-candidate would require. docs/wrf_ruc_runtime_admission.md is the record.

THE COST, MEASURED AT PRODUCTION WIDTH AND NOT EXTRAPOLATED. On an RTX 5090, d04 of the four-domain production case (600x600 = 360,000 columns, dt=1.667 s, bldt=0 so the land surface runs every step): 16.8 wall seconds per simulated minute on snow-free land and 65.7 on a FULLY snow-covered domain. For scale the whole four-domain MYNN stack is 27 s per simulated minute, so a snow-covered RUC d04 costs more than the rest of the model and a warm one costs less. A 12-hour d04 forecast is therefore 3.4 hours of land surface warm and 13 hours fully snow-covered. There is deliberately no column-count rail refusing wide grids the way Noah-MP has one: Noah-MP's rail exists because its call CANNOT FINISH, and RUC's d04 call is 0.47 s warm and 1.83 s over snow. The number is published here so it is read before the run, not discovered during it.

OFFERED FOR THE DIRECT hrrr AND era5 SOURCES. gfs was withdrawn in v1.1.1: a GFS-initialised RUC forecast prepares in full and then cannot take its first step, because the GFS route supplies none of the soil/surface fields RUC's land surface reads (tests/test_ruc_admission.py V-1 cases). The omission of 20crv3/mapped preparation is likewise not an oversight. gpuwm/mapped_direct.py hands the soil seam the composition's DECLARATIVE layer contract, and gpuwm/ingest/soil_contract.py validate_soil_layer_contract still declares exactly one target -- Noah's four layers -- refusing RUC's nine by name because they are a different discretization with a different value-location convention rather than a longer list of the same thing. Admitting the mapped source needs that target added and its remap proved against a WRF-real nine-level initialization, and widening the comparison would fabricate a soil column.

A RUC domain carries nine soil layers where every other gpuwm template carries four, so its restart files, its wrfout soil variables and its VRAM budget are not interchangeable with a Noah run's, and a nest tree cannot mix the two.

What is established: every routine of the column is oracle-matched against the byte-unmodified module_sf_ruclsm.F; the assembled driver is bitwise against oracle/lsmruc.csv except its 26 pinned upstream-residue cells; the CUDA column the forecast actually launches is max_ulp 0 against that host driver over all 43 returned fields at 512, 4,096 and 24,576 columns, warm and snow-covered, measured paired in one process (tests/test_ruc_device_column.py); and sf_surface_physics=3 forecasts, restarts bit for bit and writes nine-layer output (tests/test_ruc_runtime.py). What is NOT established is a gpuwm/WRF forecast-trajectory comparison, which is what validation-candidate would require. docs/wrf_ruc_runtime_admission.md is the record.

This template differs from wsm6-ysu-mm5-noah-no-radiation-v1 in exactly ONE selector -- sf_surface_physics 2 -> 3, with num_soil_layers 4 -> 9 following from it -- so a side-by-side run isolates the land-surface change from the microphysics, PBL, surface layer, radiation, cumulus and diffusion settings.

THE COST, MEASURED AT PRODUCTION WIDTH AND NOT EXTRAPOLATED. On an RTX 5090, d04 of the four-domain production case (600x600 = 360,000 columns, dt=1.667 s, bldt=0 so the land surface runs every step): 16.8 wall seconds per simulated minute on snow-free land and 65.7 on a FULLY snow-covered domain. For scale the whole four-domain MYNN stack is 27 s per simulated minute, so a snow-covered RUC d04 costs more than the rest of the model and a warm one costs less. A 12-hour d04 forecast is therefore 3.4 hours of land surface warm and 13 hours fully snow-covered. There is deliberately no column-count rail refusing wide grids the way Noah-MP has one: Noah-MP's rail exists because its call CANNOT FINISH, and RUC's d04 call is 0.47 s warm and 1.83 s over snow. The number is published here so it is read before the run, not discovered during it.

OFFERED FOR THE DIRECT hrrr AND era5 SOURCES. gfs was withdrawn in v1.1.1: a GFS-initialised RUC forecast prepares in full and then cannot take its first step, because the GFS route supplies none of the soil/surface fields RUC's land surface reads (tests/test_ruc_admission.py V-1 cases). The omission of 20crv3/mapped preparation is likewise not an oversight. gpuwm/mapped_direct.py hands the soil seam the composition's DECLARATIVE layer contract, and gpuwm/ingest/soil_contract.py validate_soil_layer_contract still declares exactly one target -- Noah's four layers -- refusing RUC's nine by name because they are a different discretization with a different value-location convention rather than a longer list of the same thing. Admitting the mapped source needs that target added and its remap proved against a WRF-real nine-level initialization, and widening the comparison would fabricate a soil column.

A RUC domain carries nine soil layers where every other gpuwm template carries four, so its restart files, its wrfout soil variables and its VRAM budget are not interchangeable with a Noah run's, and a nest tree cannot mix the two.

THE NAME IS WRONG AND THE ID IS FROZEN. This template's id says 'no-radiation'; its radiation component is 'dudhia-shortwave', which is ra_lw_physics 0 with ra_sw_physics 1 -- WRF's Dudhia SHORTWAVE scheme RUNS, and no longwave scheme does. Downward longwave is therefore never computed: GLW stays at zero (WRF's own value for a longwave-free run, phys/module_physics_init.F:1168-1170 and phys/module_radiation_driver.F:1719-1722) for the entire forecast, and every land-surface model reads it every step. That makes this a DAYTIME-ONLY suite: a real window containing local night refuses to load unless [experiment] declares acknowledgements = ["asymmetric-radiation-nocturnal-window-v1"]. Read the label, not the id -- the label has always named Dudhia SW. The id is not being corrected because it is quoted by shipped configs, evidence receipts and user plans; this warning, the label and docs/public/PHYSICS.md are the authority on what the option runs.
